name: BSAMR Data Representation and SFC Indexing
definition: BSAMR (Block-Structured AMR) is a hierarchical data structure where each time step (gamma) contains a sequence of Level of Detail (LOD) grids. LODs are nested: LOD0 covers the entire domain, LOD1 is nested in LOD0, etc., ensuring no empty space. A 'brick' is a group of voxels loaded as a unit.
